commission_rules_value.name: commission_rules_value
commission_rules_value.value:
("commission_rules"."type" = 'percent' and "commission_rules"."percent_bps" between 0 and 10000 and "commission_rules"."amount_cents" is null)
        or ("commission_rules"."type" = 'fixed' and "commission_rules"."amount_cents" >= 0 and "commission_rules"."percent_bps" is null)

payment_items_ref.name: payment_items_ref
payment_items_ref.value: ("payment_items"."kind" = 'service' and "payment_items"."product_id" is null) or ("payment_items"."kind" = 'product' and "payment_items"."product_id" is not null)
